授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course provides not only knowledge of mathematics but also skills of using it effectively in applications. Mathematical concepts and techniques including partial differentiation, multiple integrals, vector analysis, ordinary differential equations are introduced. A wide range of applications of these powerful techniques, especially applications in the physical sciences, is studied. In addition, in order to develop skills necessary to use these tools in later courses or future career, students practice solving several problems.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: partial differentiation, multiple integrals, vector analysis, ordinary differential equations, Laplace transform

"This course is a DX subject for developing DNA (Digital Native in Agriculture) human resources. You can acquire the following digital mind and skills (DMS).
1. You can learn about mathematical concepts which are necessary for data science and machine learning (deep learning).
2. You can acquire the knowledge and skills to model a phenomenon using mathematics (ordinary/partial differential equations) which can be solve numerically."
